slides.title: Start Exploring
slides.intro: GScale works for all skill levels. Here's how to get the most out of it.

steps.title: Pick an instrument
steps.desc: Use the instrument dropdown to navigate to Guitar, Piano, Kalimba, Harmonica, Flute, or Recorder

steps.title: Choose a scale and root
steps.desc: Select from 60+ built-in scales or create your own, then pick a root note

steps.title: Click notes to hear them
steps.desc: Every highlighted note on every instrument is clickable — use it for ear training

steps.title: Adjust your view
steps.desc: Toggle degrees/names, sharps/flats, color/mono, and dark/light to suit your preference

steps.title: Customize further
steps.desc: For guitar: adjust tuning, fret count, texture, orientation, and enable/disable specific strings or frets

steps.title: Save and share
steps.desc: Export your custom scales and tunings to back them up or share with others

slides.title: Welcome to GScale
slides.subtitle: Musical Scale Visualization Tool
slides.intro: An interactive app for visualizing and learning musical scales across multiple instruments. Click any note to hear it, customize your view, and explore 60+ scales.

slides.title: Navigating the Interface
slides.intro: The header bar contains all global controls, accessible from any instrument page.

features.title: Instrument Selector
features.desc: Switch between Guitar, Piano, Kalimba, Harmonica, Flute, and Recorder using the instrument dropdown

features.title: Scale & Root Selectors
features.desc: Choose from 60+ scale types and any root note (C through B, sharps and flats)

features.title: Degrees / Note Names
features.desc: Toggle between scale degree numbers (1–7) and note names (C, D, E…)

features.title: Flats / Sharps
features.desc: Switch note display between flat (♭) and sharp (♯) notation

features.title: Color / Monochrome
features.desc: Color mode highlights each interval; monochrome mode shows only root notes

features.title: Dark / Light Theme
features.desc: Toggle between dark and light modes — preference is saved automatically

slides.title: Scale Library & Custom Scales
slides.intro: GScale ships with over 60 built-in scales. You can also create your own.

features.title: 60+ Built-in Scales
features.desc: Covers Major, Minor, Pentatonic, Blues, Jazz Bebop, Modes (Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian…), and Exotic scales (Hungarian Minor, Byzantine, Persian…)

features.title: Custom Scale Editor
features.desc: Open the scale dropdown and select '+ Create Custom Scale' to build a scale from scratch by picking intervals

features.title: Interval Picker
features.desc: Select any combination of the 12 semitones to define your scale — a live C preview updates as you choose

features.title: Name & Categorize
features.desc: Give your scale a name and category so it appears grouped with similar scales in the dropdown

features.title: Edit or Delete
features.desc: Custom scales can be edited or deleted at any time from the scale editor

slides.title: Guitar — Fretboard Setup
slides.intro: The Guitar page offers the most configuration options. All settings are saved automatically.

features.title: Tuning Presets
features.desc: Choose from dozens of preset tunings (Standard, Drop D, Open G, DADGAD, and many more) organized by category

features.title: Base Tuning Transposition
features.desc: Shift the entire tuning up or down by semitone using the Base Tuning selector

features.title: Fret Count
features.desc: Display 12, 20, 21, 22, 23, or 24 frets to match your instrument

features.title: Fretboard Texture
features.desc: Choose a visual texture: Rosewood, Pale Moon Ebony, Maple, Pau Ferro, or Richlite

features.title: Flip Horizontally
features.desc: Mirror the fretboard left-to-right — useful for left-handed players

features.title: Flip Vertically
features.desc: Mirror the fretboard top-to-bottom to match your preferred string order

features.title: String Spacing
features.desc: Switch between Normal and Enlarged spacing for better readability

slides.title: Guitar — String & Fret Control
slides.intro: Focus on any part of the neck by enabling or disabling individual strings and fret positions.

features.title: String Checkboxes
features.desc: Each string has a checkbox on the left side — uncheck to hide that string from the visualization

features.title: Fret Checkboxes
features.desc: Each fret column has a checkbox at the bottom — uncheck to hide that fret position

features.title: Enable / Disable All
features.desc: The button at the axis junction toggles all strings AND all frets at once — great for isolating a specific region then re-enabling everything

features.title: Custom Tunings
features.desc: Create your own tuning: set the number of strings (4–18), name each string note, and save it alongside the presets

features.title: Multiscale / Fanned Frets
features.desc: Enable multiscale mode to set independent treble and bass scale lengths, with a configurable perpendicular fret

slides.title: Piano
slides.intro: The Piano page shows an interactive keyboard with scale notes highlighted.

features.title: Octave Count
features.desc: Select 1, 2, 3, or 4 octaves to display — your choice is saved automatically

features.title: Click to Play
features.desc: Click any highlighted key to hear the note played through the Web Audio API

features.title: Color-Coded Intervals
features.desc: Scale notes are colored by degree (even degrees in green, odd in orange, root in high contrast). Non-scale notes are grayed out.

features.title: Keyboard Accessible
features.desc: Tab to a key and press Enter or Space to play it

slides.title: Kalimba
slides.intro: The Kalimba page shows a traditional 17-key thumb piano layout.

features.title: 17-Key Layout
features.desc: Tines are arranged center-outward in alternating left/right order, matching a real kalimba

features.title: Click to Play
features.desc: Click any tine to hear it. Scale notes are color-highlighted; non-scale notes are visible but grayed out

features.title: Interval Colors
features.desc: Same color scheme as other instruments — colored or monochrome based on your global display setting

features.title: Note Labels
features.desc: Each tine shows the note name, flat/sharp, or scale degree depending on your display toggle

slides.title: Harmonica
slides.intro: The Harmonica page shows a standard 10-hole diatonic harmonica layout.

features.title: Blow & Draw Notes
features.desc: Each hole shows both the blow note (↑) and the draw note (↓) side by side

features.title: Harmonica Key Selector
features.desc: Choose the key of your harmonica (C, G, A, D, F, B♭, E♭) — all notes transpose automatically

features.title: Click to Play
features.desc: Click any blow or draw note to hear it. Only scale notes are active; others are grayed out

features.title: Hole Numbers
features.desc: Holes are numbered 1–10 as standard harmonica reference

slides.title: Flute & Recorder
slides.intro: The Flute and Recorder pages show a fingering diagram for each note of the scale.

features.title: Fingering Diagrams
features.desc: Each scale note is drawn as a playable fingering — filled holes/keys are covered, hollow ones are open

features.title: Recorder Type
features.desc: Pick the recorder size — Sopranino, Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass, Great Bass, Contrabass, Sub-contrabass — grouped by key (in C / in F). Fingerings stay the same; the sounding pitch transposes.

features.title: Notes to Display
features.desc: Choose how many consecutive scale notes to lay out (1, 3, 5, 7, 12, or 24)

features.title: Click to Play
features.desc: Click any diagram to hear that note

slides.note: Recorder fingerings use the Baroque (English) system, shared across all recorder sizes.

slides.title: Custom Tunings
slides.intro: Create, edit, and manage guitar tunings directly in the app.

features.title: Create a Tuning
features.desc: Select '+ Custom Tuning' in the tuning dropdown to open the tuning editor

features.title: String Count
features.desc: Set anywhere from 4 to 18 strings — each gets its own note picker

features.title: Duplicate a Tuning
features.desc: Use the duplicate button to copy an existing tuning as a starting point for a variation

features.title: Edit or Delete
features.desc: Custom tunings can be renamed, modified, or deleted at any time

features.title: Persistent Storage
features.desc: All custom tunings are saved to local storage and survive page refreshes

slides.title: Settings, Export & Import
slides.intro: Access the Settings panel via the gear icon in the header to manage your configuration.

features.title: Export Settings
features.desc: Download all your settings (custom scales, custom tunings, display preferences) as a JSON file with a timestamped filename

features.title: Import Settings
features.desc: Load a previously exported settings file to restore your configuration — on any device

features.title: Import Validation
features.desc: The importer checks version compatibility and reports which settings were applied and which were skipped

features.title: Reset to Defaults
features.desc: The Reset button restores all settings to factory defaults after a confirmation prompt

features.title: Auto-Save
features.desc: Every setting change is saved automatically to localStorage — no manual save needed

slides.note: Use Export/Import to back up your custom scales and tunings or share them with others.
